rows: Hold A to set power, release to cast
Pull back (D-pad) when the bobber/line twitches
Ease off when the line meter turns red

widgets.text: Topwater lures work early and late in the day; crankbaits and worms for deeper water in the midday heat. Match the lure colour to water clarity: bright in murky water, natural in clear.
Big bass run: let them pull against light drag instead of reeling, then reel when they turn. Jumps can throw the hook: keep tension steady.
Tournaments move between lakes; each lake has weed beds, drop-offs and docks. Bass hold near cover.
Winnings buy new rods, reels and lures between tournaments.
The record book keeps your heaviest catch per lake.
Win tournaments to qualify for the championship; standings rank anglers by the total weight of their best catches.
